# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release and the `main` branch receive fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems. Use GitHub's private reporting instead:
**Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability** on [xRookieFight/dynmap-pnx](https://github.com/xRookieFight/dynmap-pnx/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected version, how to reproduce it and what an attacker could do with it. You should get a first response within a week.

Issues in the Dynmap web server or core that are not specific to this port should also be reported to [webbukkit/dynmap](https://github.com/webbukkit/dynmap).
